en.name: Sorghum, whole grain
en.summary: Whole grain sorghum keeps about 4 months in a sealed container in the cupboard and 8 months in the freezer at −18 °C (0 °F). It has a tough, intact hull, which helps, but it is still a whole grain with its germ, and that is what runs out first.
en.pantry: Keep it airtight in a cool, dark, dry cupboard and use it within about 4 months. Sorghum is usually sold unhulled or lightly pearled, and the intact grain protects the germ reasonably well — but the oil is there, and that is what turns. Buy the size of bag you will finish, keep it away from the stove and out of the light, and decant it into a sealed jar rather than leaving it in the bag, since sorghum is as attractive to pantry moths as any other grain.
en.fridge: No refrigerator timeline is published for sorghum, so none is offered here. An airtight jar in the fridge is a reasonable place for an opened bag in a hot, humid kitchen — cold slows the germ oil turning and keeps insects out — as long as the container seals properly and comes back to room temperature before you open it, so condensation forms on the jar rather than on the grain.
en.freezer: The freezer doubles it, to about 8 months at −18 °C (0 °F), in an airtight container or a heavy bag with the air pressed out. That is the right answer for a bulk bag and it settles any weevil question too. Sorghum needs a long simmer whether or not it has been frozen, so cook it straight from frozen. Frozen food stays safe indefinitely at −18 °C; the months are about quality.
spoilage: A bitter or paint-like smell from rancid germ oil.
A musty or damp smell, or grains clumping together.
Webbing, small moths or fine dust in the container.
Grains that stay hard in the centre however long they are simmered.
tips: Decant into an airtight jar the day you buy it and date the lid.
Freeze a large bag immediately rather than after it has sat in the cupboard.
Soak it before cooking to cut the simmering time.
Smell the grain before cooking; rancidity does not show.

faq.q: How long does whole sorghum keep?
faq.a: About 4 months airtight in a cool, dark cupboard, or 8 months at −18 °C (0 °F).
Yes, about 8 months at −18 °C in an airtight container, and you can cook it straight from frozen.

faq.q: Why does sorghum not keep as long as white rice?
faq.a: Because it is a whole grain and still has its germ. The oil in the germ turns rancid; milled white rice has had it removed.

zh.name: 全粒高粱
zh.summary: 全粒高粱密封放櫥櫃約 4 個月，−18 °C 冷凍 8 個月。它有一層堅韌完整的外殼，這是加分項，但它終究是保留胚芽的全穀，而胚芽就是最先到期的部分。
zh.pantry: 密封放陰涼、避光、乾燥的櫥櫃，約 4 個月內用完。高粱多半以未去殼或輕度拋光的形式販售，完整的穀粒對胚芽算是不錯的保護——但油脂就在那裡，而它會變質。請買你用得完的份量、遠離爐台、避免光照，並且倒進密封罐而不是留在袋子裡，因為高粱對穀蛾的吸引力不輸其他穀物。
zh.fridge: 高粱沒有公布的冷藏期限，本頁也不提供。在濕熱的廚房裡，開封後裝密封罐放冰箱是合理的做法——低溫延緩胚芽油脂變質，也擋得住蟲——前提是容器確實密封，而且開封前先回到室溫，讓水氣凝在罐子上而不是穀粒上。
zh.freezer: 冷凍讓時間加倍，−18 °C 下約 8 個月，裝密封容器或厚袋壓出空氣。大包裝就該這樣處理，也順便解決米蟲問題。不管有沒有冷凍過，高粱都要久煮，所以直接從冷凍下鍋即可。−18 °C 下安全性是無限期的，月數講的是品質。
spoilage: 聞到胚芽油走油耗後的苦味或油漆味。
有潮霉味，或穀粒結成塊。
容器內出現絲網、小蛾或細粉屑。
不管燉多久，中心還是硬的。
tips: 買回來當天倒進密封罐，並在蓋子上寫日期。
大包裝馬上冷凍，不要先在櫥櫃放一陣子。
煮之前先泡水，可以縮短燉煮時間。
煮之前先聞；油耗是看不出來的。

faq.a: 密封、陰涼避光的櫥櫃約 4 個月，或 −18 °C 冷凍 8 個月。
可以，−18 °C 下密封容器約 8 個月，而且能直接從冷凍下鍋煮。

faq.q: 高粱為什麼不像白米那麼耐放？
faq.a: 因為它是全穀、還帶著胚芽，而胚芽裡的油會走油耗。精白米已經把胚芽去掉了。
